headline: SK하이닉스 주가, 최근 1주일새 약 13.6% 급등 (10/27 1,369,000원)
facts: Investing.com에 따르면 SK Hynix stock surged 6.8% to 1,362,000 won on Tuesday(10/27) amid reports that the memory chip maker was planning to unveil bumper shareholder return plans with its third-quarter earnings due on Wednesday.

South Korean media outlet Dong-A Ilbo reported the chipmaker is considering a special dividend distribution of approximately 16 trillion Korean won, or about $12 billion, funded largely by SK Hynix’s sale of its stake in Japanese memory chip maker Kioxia.

SK Hynix is set to release its full Q3 2026 results before 9:00 a.m. Seoul time on October 28, with market consensus pointing to record quarterly revenue in the range of approximately 96 to 99 trillion won and operating profit exceeding 75 trillion won.

SK Hynix also tracked gains in the overnight U.S. session, which saw a broad recovery in AI-linked semiconductor names, with Anthropic’s IPO filing serving as a key sentiment catalyst that revived confidence in sustained AI infrastructure investment.

26일 한경 보도에 따르면, 전날 급락에 따른 반발매수세 유입과 중국 기업이 엔비디아에 350억달러가 넘는 규모의 제품을 주문했지만 공급 부족으로 5∼10%만 공급받을 수 있다는 소식이 위축된 투자심리에 온기를 불어넣었고, 미국 AI 서버 제조업체 슈퍼마이크로컴퓨터 실적이 시장 전망치를 웃돈 것과 10월 1∼20일 수출액 잠정치가 전년 동기 대비 105% 증가한 점도 반도체 대형주 주가에 호재로 작용했다.
코스피는 10/27 장 초반 미국 AI주 투자심리 회복에 힘입어 3% 넘게 급등하며 5600선을 회복했고, 외국인이 2000억원 넘게 순매수에 나선 가운데 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 반도체 대형주가 지수 상승을 주도했다.
다만 이번 반등의 지속 여부는 주 중반 이후 예정된 10월 FOMC와 미국 빅테크·삼성전자·SK하이닉스 실적 발표 등 대형 이벤트에 달려있다는 분석이 나왔다.

SK Hynix controls half of the fast-growing HBM market according to Counterpoint Research estimates, and the stock's recent Q2 revenue rose 257% year-over-year, underscoring AI memory demand as a fundamental driver.

구분: 이번 급등은 Fundamental 요인(특별배당 16조원 보도, 10/28 예정 사상 최대 분기 영업이익 전망, HBM 수요 및 수출 호조 등 실적/정책성 재료)과 외부 투기적·심리적 요인(Anthropic IPO 신청에 따른 AI 섹터 전반 투자심리 회복, 전주 급락에 따른 반발매수)이 복합적으로 작용한 것으로, 단일 원인으로 분리하기 어려운 복합 요인에 해당한다.

headline: 메타(META) 주가, 3분기 실적 발표 후 1주일새 약 -10.6% 하락 (10/26 종가 $630.56)
facts: 이 변동은 외부 충격이 아닌 펀더멘털(실적 발표·자본지출 가이던스) 요인에 의한 것으로, 10월 21일 3분기 실적 발표 후 연쇄적인 하락이 이어졌다.
<cite index="6-2,6-3">Shares of Meta Platforms (META) fell 7.0% on Thursday, October 22, 2026, while the S&P 500 lost 1.2%. The drop came a day after Meta reported its third-quarter results</cite>

<cite index="14-2,14-3">Meta said it expects its full-year capex to range from $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the bottom of the range from a previous $130 billion. Free cash flow came in at a negative $2.12 billion during the quarter.</cite>

<cite index="15-17,15-18">Capex of $34.9 billion exceeded operating cash flow of $32.8 billion, producing free cash flow of negative $2.1 billion. The result is the first negative free cash flow since the company went public in 2012.</cite>

<cite index="14-4,14-5">Revenue for the social media giant jumped 26% in the third quarter from a year ago, coming in at $64.60 billion versus the $63.37 billion analysts expected. Earnings per share were reported at $3.83, though it wasn't clear if it was directly comparable with the $5.75 per share Wall Street was looking for.</cite>

<cite index="6-14,6-15">Meta kept 20.1% of its fiscal Q3 2026 revenue as operating profit, against 40.1% in fiscal Q3 2025. Management said on the call that most of that drop came from a $9.9 billion legal charge tied to the August 2026 multistate attorneys general agreement.</cite>

<cite index="7-9,7-10,7-11">Management now expects capital expenditures to be between $135 billion and $145 billion for the full year, up from its previous guidance of $130 billion. Lastly, Meta plans to offer a new class of nonvoting shares to help finance this growth. This means dilution for current investors is very much on the table.</cite>

<cite index="14-1">The spread on the social media giant's five-year credit default swaps reached all-time highs on Thursday, a signal of growing credit concerns from investors as the company leans deeper into its artificial intelligence spending plans.</cite>

<cite index="2-1,2-2">On October 26, 2026, Meta Platforms Inc META shares fell 1.9%, closing at $630.56. The stock is currently trading within a 52-week range of $520.26 to $779.82, reflecting a significant decline from its recent highs.</cite>

<cite index="3-4,3-5">Shares fell around 7% on Oct. 22, after the company said third-quarter revenue rose 26% year over year. This followed post-earnings drops of about 9% on April 30 and 8% on July 30.</cite>
